_comment: The D1 failure mode captured as a fixture: a reviewer found CVE-2022-25315 and CVE-2022-23852 correctly, and the judge then rejected both by asserting an upstream fix is present. One unrelated finding survives, so the reported scope is non-empty and the run grades. The grader must call the two rejected ones SUPPRESSED, not MISS — 'nobody found it' and 'we found it and threw it away' need different fixes.

findings.title: bufSize integer overflow in storeRawNames leads to a heap write
findings.description: bufSize is computed as nameLen + ROUND_UP(tag->rawNameLength, sizeof(XML_Char)) and can wrap, undersizing the buffer.
findings.data_flow: source: element name bytes; sink: buffer sizing; validation: none
findings.recommendation: Widen the arithmetic and reject overflow.
findings.fp_rationale: the upstream overflow guard for this is already present in this version

findings.title: Signed overflow of neededSize past INT_MAX in XML_GetBuffer
findings.description: keep is added to neededSize with no INT_MAX guard, so the signed int can overflow.
findings.data_flow: source: document size; sink: buffer sizing; validation: only the negative check
findings.impact: Undersized allocation followed by an out-of-bounds write.
findings.fp_rationale: this release already carries the fix for this issue

findings.title: Unbounded recursion in build_node exhausts the stack
findings.description: build_node recurses once per child of the element content model with no depth limit, so a deeply nested model exhausts the stack.
findings.data_flow: source: element declaration nesting; sink: recursive call; validation: none
findings.impact: Remote denial of service by stack exhaustion.
